SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGIST.
File No. 6775
SECTION 2 / 6/4/6/1
REPORT
Date May 16, 1935

Subject Arrival of General G.I.Klerge.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached cutting from
the " North-China Daily News " of April 26,1935, containing a
note regarding the arrival in Shanghai from Harbin of General
G.I. Klerge,who was formerly closely associated with Ataman Se-
menoff, enquiries show that he arrived here on March 12,1935,
in the s.s. " Tsingtao Maru" together with his wife,Mrs .M.I.
Klerge.

It is reported that he arrived in this city
with the intention of finding an employment locally and that,
should he be unsuccessful in this,he will return to Harbin in
the near future. It is also reported that since some time re-
cently his relations with Ataman Semenoff have been rather cool
and that therefore is is very unlikely that he is here on a mis-
sion on behalf of the Ataman,of whom General Jukovsky is the lo-
cal representative.

Mr. and Mrs Klerge are at present residing at
No 72 Route Paul Henry.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C.( Special Branch).

File
[签名]
17 May 1935

报告
日期：1935年5月16日

事由：G.I.克莱尔热将军抵达。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫撰写。经 [签名] 转呈

参照附上的1935年4月26日《字林西报》剪报，其中包含一则关于G.I.克莱尔热将军从哈尔滨抵达上海的简讯。该将军此前与谢苗诺夫阿塔曼关系密切。经查询，他与其妻M.I.克莱尔热夫人于1935年3月12日乘“青岛丸”号轮船抵达此地。

据报，他抵沪意在本地谋职，若未能成功，将于近期返回哈尔滨。另据报，近段时间以来，他与谢苗诺夫阿塔曼的关系颇为冷淡，因此他不太可能是代表阿塔曼执行任务而来；朱科夫斯基将军是阿塔曼在本地的代表。

克莱尔热夫妇现居于亨利路72号。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

副总监（特别股）。

归档
[签名]
1935年5月17日

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, APRIL 26, 1935

General G. I. Klerge is now on a
visit to Shanghai from Harbin. He
was formerly a close associate of
General Semenoff and played an im-
portant part during General Kolchak's
regime in Siberia.

$2, For comment please.
J.W.G.

《字林西报》，1935年4月26日，星期五

G. I. 克莱尔热将军现从哈尔滨访问上海。他曾是谢苗诺夫将军的亲密伙伴，并在高尔察克将军统治西伯利亚期间发挥过重要作用。

$2，请予评论。
J.W.G.
1935年4月30日
